title: Computational studies suggest compounds restoring function of p53 cancer mutants can bind SARS-CoV-2 spike protein.
one_liner_zh: 该文用计算模拟研究小分子与SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白结合，虽涉及分子动力学，但对象为病毒蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: It is reasonable to think that cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy or immunotherapy may have a more aggressive course if they are positive for the novel coronavirus disease. Their compulsive condition requires investigation into effective drugs. We applied computational techniques to a series of compounds known for restoring the function of p53 cancer mutant p53(R175H) and p53(G245S). Two potent inhibitors, 1-(3-chlorophenyl)-3-(1, 3 -thiazol-2-yl) urea (CTU, PubChem NSC321792) with the highest binding affinity -6.92 kcal/mol followed by a thiosemicarbazone compound N'-(1-(Pyridin-2-yl)ethylidene) azetidine - 1 -carbothiohydrazide (NPC, PubChem NSC319726) with -6.75 kcal/mol were subjected to Molecular Dynamics simulation with receptor binding domain (RBD) and compared with control ligand dexamethasone. In particular, CTU adheres to pocket 1 with an average free energy of binding -21.65 +/- 2.89 kcal/mol at the RBD - angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 binding region with the highest frequency of amino acid residues after reaching a local equilibrium in 100 ns MD simulation trajectory. A significant enthalpy contribution from the independent simulations unfolds the possibility of dual binding sites for NPC as shifted pocket 1 (-15.59 +/- 5.98 kcal/mol) and pocket 2 (-18.90 +/- 5.02 kcal/mol). The obtained results for these two compounds are in good agreement with dexamethasone (-18.45  +/- 2.42 kcal/mol). Taken together our findings could facilitate the discovery of small molecules that restore the function of p53 cancer mutants newly against COVID-19 in cancer patients.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 有理由认为，接受化疗或免疫治疗的癌症患者若新型冠状病毒检测呈阳性，其病程可能更为凶险。其紧迫状况要求探索有效药物。我们将计算技术应用于一系列已知可恢复p53癌症突变体p53(R175H)和p53(G245S)功能的化合物。两种强效抑制剂，即1-(3-氯苯基)-3-(1,3-噻唑-2-基)脲（CTU，PubChem NSC321792），其结合亲和力最高，为-6.92 kcal/mol，其次是缩氨基硫脲化合物N'-(1-(吡啶-2-基)亚乙基)氮杂环丁烷-1-硫代碳酰肼（NPC，PubChem NSC319726），为-6.75 kcal/mol，被用于与受体结合域（RBD）进行分子动力学模拟，并与对照配体地塞米松进行比较。特别地，CTU在100 ns分子动力学模拟轨迹中达到局部平衡后，以平均结合自由能-21.65 +/- 2.89 kcal/mol粘附于口袋1，位于RBD-血管紧张素转换酶2结合区域，且氨基酸残基出现频率最高。独立模拟中显著的焓贡献揭示了NPC可能具有双重结合位点，即口袋1（-15.59 +/- 5.98 kcal/mol）和口袋2（-18.90 +/- 5.02 kcal/mol）。这两种化合物所得结果与地塞米松（-18.45 +/- 2.42 kcal/mol）高度一致。综合来看，我们的发现可能有助于发现能够恢复p53癌症突变体功能的小分子，从而新近对抗癌症患者中的COVID-19。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
